newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saint-Louis eyes 20-25 pct Ebro-Azucarera stake.
newsitem.headline: Saint-Louis eyes 20-25 pct Ebro-Azucarera stake.

text.p: The chairman of Saint-Louis said in a newspaper interview the French group planned to acquire between 20 and 25 percent of the new company created by the merger of Spain's largest sugar producers Ebro Agricolas and Sociedad General de Azucarera de Espana (Azucarera).
"We would like to take a stake of between 20 and 25 percent in the new group. In any case we would not exceed that level," Daniel Melin told industry weekly Le Betteravier Francais.
Saint-Louis already owns, through its Generale Sucriere unit, 20.35 percent of Azucarera.
The newly-merged group would control 782,474 tonnes of sugar, representing some 75 percent of Spain's quota in the European Union, Le Betteravier Francais said.
